queries_run: Parker-Hannifin business model transition subscription OR platform OR e-commerce 2026

findings.claim: FY2026 10-K 描述的通路仍是現場業務員＋獨立經銷商，OEM 與經銷商（售後替換市場）並行；未見訂閱化、D2C 或平台化的結構性轉變描述。搜尋也未找到公司對通路策略改變的說法。
findings.excerpt: We market our Diversified Industrial Segment products primarily through field sales employees and independent distributors located throughout the world.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋查無訂閱／平台／電商轉型來源；僅見經銷商庫存循環與訂單改採滾動12個月報告（屬報告方式，非通路改變），未取得可逐字原文故不列為 finding。
